measurements.ingestion_observation: Host monotonic POST start to first observed indexed hit; includes poll interval, not exact ingest latency
measurements.monitoring: Worker first seen to Detection persistence using Docker VM timestamps and trace lineage
measurements.incident_creation: Detection persisted_at to Incident created_at using validated shared clock
measurements.end_to_end: Host monotonic request start to first observed durable incident revision; includes observation interval
measurements.queue_wait: Durable source created/ready to claim/dispatched timestamp only after clock validation
measurements.resources: CPU %, bytes memory, and SQLite page_count*page_size; ELK metrics from isolated nodes stats only

never: LLM accuracy or real-provider latency from mock
